messages:
marta: CI red on nightly run — TestRetryOrdering failing 3/5 on linux-x86 (nightly). https://ci.example.com/build/9898 :grimacing:
jamal: :eyes: can you paste the failing log / assertion?
marta: log snippet below (sorry messy):
```
thread 'test_retry_ordering' panicked at 'window end < start', retry_manager.rs:214:9
stack backtrace:
  0: retry_manager::check_window
  1: runtime::tests::test_retry_ordering
  2: std::rt::lang_start::{{closure}}
```
liam: hmm looks like timer window math. any seed printed?
marta: test prints seed at start — seed=14159265
zoe: @sre-oncall can you take a quick bisect / rerun? looks nondeterministic.
sre-oncall: starting rerun+bisect job, will attempt 50 seeds and report. kicking off now.
ci-bot: Rerun job queued: `./ci/rerun --test TestRetryOrdering --attempts 50` 
Link: https://ci.example.com/reruns/777
jamal: if anyone can try local with ASAN + single-thread (`RUST_TEST_THREADS=1`) that'd help narrow down data race vs scheduler.
marta: repro is flaky locally too. sometimes passes when run single-thread, sometimes fails.
liam: that leans toward a timing/synchronization issue. can you run with `--nocapture` and add timestamps to events?
marta: here is a tiny timeline from one failing run:
```
[00:00:00.010] send retry request id=7
[00:00:00.011] retry_manager: schedule window start=100, end=90
[00:00:00.011] timer fired for id=7
[00:00:00.011] assert!(end >= start) failed -- end=90 start=100
```
liam: whoa end < start — maybe integer overflow or unsigned underflow after subtracting jitter.
zoe: quick mitigation: mark test flaky to stop noisy alerts while we fix. I can add a label/ignore in CI for nightly.
sre-oncall: applying small patch to run deterministic clock in test harness and re-running smoke. will update when done.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: 7/50 seeds produced failure. Reproducer seed=8371. https://ci.example.com/reruns/777/result
marta: awesome, will start bisecting locally with seed=8371 and try to minimize to a repro. will open PR with reproducer & failing trace if I get a minimal case.
jamal: :thumbsup: ping me on the PR, I can take first pass on reducer / bisect script.
liam: also recommend adding an assert on the math to fail earlier and capture values, then we can identify root cause faster.
zoe: created issue #1423 and added rerun link + seed info + current hypothesis. tagging eng-runtime. moving follow-ups to issue to keep slack noise down. thanks all.
marta: thanks — will update issue with bisect results.
